name: Price & Cart Hider – WooCommerce Catalog Mode, Wholesale & B2B
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
🚀 Premium Addons for Your Store:
* Price & Cart Hider (PRO) – Professional Catalog Mode & B2B pricing control.
* Conditional Store Restrictions (PRO) – The ultimate access control engine for WooCommerce.

Price & Cart Hider for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the ultimate solution to securely transform your WooCommerce store into a flexible Catalog Mode, Wholesale, or B2B storefront quickly and easily.

Effortlessly hide prices and remove “Add to Cart” buttons based on your own granular rules—by product, category, or tag—without writing a single line of PHP code. Ideal for store owners who need to disable checkout, hide prices for guest users to force registration, or run a wholesale or B2B WooCommerce catalog alongside retail.

✨ Key Features

  • WooCommerce Catalog Mode: Easily turn your entire store into a product catalog by disabling purchasing options globally or conditionally.
  • Hide Prices Anywhere: Remove or completely hide product prices globally, or selectively for specific target items.
  • Hide Add to Cart Button: Disable the immediate purchasing ability while keeping your beautiful product catalog completely visible to visitors.
  • Wholesale & B2B Ready: Perfect for hiding standard retail prices from guest users while securely displaying them to logged-in wholesale customers.
  • Custom Replacement Text: Display powerful calls to action instead of empty space, such as “Login to View Price”, “Call for Price”, or “Contact Us for Pricing”.
  • Flexible Rule System: Apply complex visibility settings to specific Products, Categories, or Tags.
  • Exclude Specific Products: Keep absolute control over visibility exclusions (e.g., show prices for standard items but hide them for flagship products).
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built natively for WooCommerce with performance and simplicity in mind—this plugin will never slow down your frontend.
  • Theme Compatible: Engineered to work seamlessly with Astra, OceanWP, WoodMart, Divi, and more.

💼 Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores: Hide wholesale bulk prices from standard retail visitors.
  • Catalog-Only Websites: Display your full premium product range to capture leads without providing immediate ecommerce checkout.
  • B2B Marketplaces: Offer specific, negotiated pricing for business partners.
  • Membership-Based Shops: Restrict top-tier pricing and purchasing only to registered VIP members.
  • Pre-Launch Stores: Show upcoming products dynamically before they are officially available for sale.

Why Choose VerseSofts?

We build professional-grade tools to help your WooCommerce store scale. Check out our Official WooCommerce Marketplace Profile for more premium solutions.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Price & Cart Hider.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to configure your visibility rules.
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices for specific products only?

Yes! You can specifically target individual products, entire product categories, or specific product tags for full granular control.

Can I show a custom message instead of hiding the price?

Absolutely. Replace the hidden price with any text message — for example, “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Pricing”.

Is this compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s latest speed and architecture standards, including HPOS and Blocks.
